newsitem.title: USA: Biocontrol Tech device approved by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Biocontrol Tech device approved by FDA.

text.p: Biocontrol Technology Inc said Tuesday the Food and Drug Administration had approved for marketing its functional electrical stimulator.

The stimulator is surgically implanted beneath the skin to replace damaged or severed nerves and stimulate muscles through electrodes by restoring lost motor functions such as hand-grasping and arm movement.
The stimulator is manufactured by Biocontrol Technology for NeuroControl Corp, which will market the device.
Biocontrol said it expects sales of the stimulator, called the NeuroControl Freehand System, to generate $1.2 million in revenue in 1997, and increased revenue in 1998.
